name: Warm Home Discount (England and Wales, 2026 to 2027)

sources.title: Warm Home Discount - If you live in England and Wales (GOV.UK)

clauses.text: Scheme covers England and Wales only; Scotland has separate rules and Northern Ireland is not covered.

On 23 August 2026, the claimant or their partner must have been receiving a qualifying means-tested benefit: Pension Credit, Housing Benefit, Universal Credit, or income-related Employment and Support Allowance.
On 23 August 2026, the claimant's or their partner's name must have been on the electricity bill.
The discount is a one-off £150 off the electricity bill.

questions.country: In which country do you live: England, Wales, Scotland, or Northern Ireland?
questions.receives_qualifying_benefit_on_whd_date: On 23 August 2026, were you or your partner receiving Pension Credit, Housing Benefit, Universal Credit, or income-related Employment and Support Allowance?
questions.electricity_bill_in_name: On 23 August 2026, was your name (or your partner's name) on the electricity bill for your home?

notes: Assumes the household's energy supplier participates in the Warm Home Discount scheme. Eligibility is assessed based on circumstances on 23 August 2026.
